title: Station kit (our own): the three station forms from the 2026-09-27 layout sketches
author: this project
notes: One .blend per station FORM (Station_OpenAir.blend, Station_GroundHub.blend, Station_ElevatedHub.blend); each OWNS its pieces. blender/tools/build_station_blends.py generated them once and keeps a piece an artist has edited.
tools/station_layout.py is the one owner of which station takes which form and of every number a piece must keep (the platform edge, the platform height, the train's gauge).
Materials are the central library's palette: the scene builder resolves every surface to kits/library/materials/<name>.tres (materials_from).
